newsitem.title: USA: Temple University, Pa., considers reorganization.
newsitem.headline: Temple University, Pa., considers reorganization.

text.p: Temple University officials are considering reorganizing the school's various departments, but the plan is "not a fait accompli," a spokesman for the university said Monday.

Temple provost James England proposed the reorganization in an outline circulated to faculty. The outline said some of the University's various divisions are not organized around a common core, and could be streamlined to save money.
The proposals include closing the Tyler School of Art's Elkins Park Campus in Montgomery County, and consolidating other departments into seven main divisions.

Rochelle Toner, dean of the Tyler School of Art, issued a statement to students Monday noting that no timetable for the proposal has been set, and implementation, if it is approved, would likely take many years.
England said he would formally make his recommendations to the school's president in May, and anticipates the Board of Trustees would consider it at its June meeting.
